verified_facts.text: Kimpton Santo is San Antonio's first Kimpton hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: San Antonio’s very first Kimpton beautifully blends a new-build hotel and a restored 1850s German-English schoolhouse

verified_facts.text: The hotel combines a new-build building with a restored 1850s German-English schoolhouse.
verified_facts.excerpt: blends a new-build hotel and a restored 1850s German-English schoolhouse

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits between downtown San Antonio and the Southtown neighborhood.
verified_facts.excerpt: the location serves as a bridge between downtown and Southtown

verified_facts.text: The schoolhouse suites overlook a historic courtyard with century-old live oaks.
verified_facts.excerpt: overlooking a historic courtyard with century-old live oaks

verified_facts.text: The Hemisfair suites are in the east wing and have floor to ceiling windows with views of the Hemisfair District.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the east wing of the hotel, our 7 Hemisfair suites feature floor to ceiling windows with views of the historic Hemisfair District.

verified_facts.text: Dean's Steak & Seafood is a steakhouse and oyster bar inside the 19th-century schoolhouse.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inside a 19th-century schoolhouse, find Dean's Steak & Seafood--a prime steakhouse and stunning oyster bar.

verified_facts.text: The Study is a cocktail lounge in one of the original 19th-century schoolhouses, with indoor and outdoor seating, cocktails and small plates.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bespoke, intimate cocktail lounge located in one of the original 19th century schoolhouses. Indoor and outdoor seating, cocktails and small plates.

verified_facts.text: Tenfold Rooftop Bar serves cocktails focused on tequila and mezcal, plus beer and wine by the glass.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tenfold Rooftop bar features inventive cocktails focusing on tequila and mezcal, along with a selection of beer and wine by the glass.

verified_facts.text: Tenfold is an open-air rooftop bar that operates year-round.
verified_facts.excerpt: Downtown San Antonio’s luxury year-round, open-air rooftop bar.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has one outdoor rooftop pool, which is heated and has private cabanas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grab a coveted spot in one of our private cabanas for a relaxing day of swimming and lounging in our heated pool

verified_facts.text: The pool deck has views of the city skyline and the hotel's historic courtyard.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the stunning city skyline and the hotel's historic courtyard while basking in the sun on the pool deck.

verified_facts.text: There is no local area shuttle and no airport shuttle at the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: There is no local area shuttle available at this hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel accepts all pets with no restrictions on pet type, size, breed or quantity.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kimpton Santo accepts all pets with no restrictions on pet type, size, breed or quantity.

verified_facts.text: Hemisfair Park, once the grounds of the 1968 World's Fair, has been revitalized into a downtown community with homes, local businesses and public parks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Visit San Antonio's Hemisfair Park, which has been revitalized into a downtown community with homes, local businesses, and public parks.

verified_facts.text: The San Antonio Riverwalk is an easy walk from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: San Antonio's top attraction is an easy walk from Kimpton Santo.

verified_facts.text: The hotel received a 2024 Preservation Project Award from The Power of Preservation Foundation.
